findings: Adapters are nominal Any-typed stubs without immutable decisions, clocks, state, terminal semantics, or identities.
Session indexing ignores causal availability, gaps, and 150-session recovery and exposes mutable mappings.
Evidence reconciliation can self-attest from arbitrary identifiers and matching hashes; stage order is unconstrained and input/output hashes are identical.
Required loader and holdout guard are absent; fixture coverage is incomplete.
Accounting charges full target gross and replaces units rather than applying turnover-based atomic portfolio reallocation and terminal liquidation.
